findings.observation: The record's title ('Evaluation of an MRI-only workflow using a commercial synthetic CT generator for brain and head-and-neck radiotherapy') does not match the actual publication. PubMed/Europe PMC list the true title as 'Development of an MR-only radiotherapy treatment planning workflow using a commercial synthetic CT generator for brain and head & neck tumor patients' (Buschmann M et al., Zeitschrift für Medizinische Physik 2025;36(1):71-83, PMID 39956751, DOI 10.1016/j.zemedi.2025.01.003). The DOI is also missing from this product's keyPaper entry.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct the title to the verified Europe PMC/PubMed title and add DOI 10.1016/j.zemedi.2025.01.003.

findings.observation: The paper enrolled 23 patients total (13 brain + 10 head-and-neck), not n=10 as implied for the brain product entry. For the Brain product the brain-only subset (n=13) is the relevant cohort; n=10 is the H&N subset documented on the H&N product page. Neither product record states the correct total/subset breakdown or that both cohorts came from one combined n=23 study.
findings.suggestedFix: State the correct cohort sizes: 23 patients total (13 brain, 10 head & neck) in a single combined study; attribute the brain subset (n=13) to this product and the H&N subset (n=10) to MRCAT Head and Neck, with a cross-reference noting it is the same source paper.

findings.observation: MESCAL (Cusumano/Maspero et al., Radiother Oncol 2026) evaluated 32 patients (16 brain, 16 pelvis) from two centers, testing MRI Planner (Spectronic), SyngoAI (Siemens), MR Box (Therapanacea) and MRCAT (Philips). Brain anatomy is within scope for this product, so the attribution here is correct.
findings.suggestedFix: No change needed; retain but note MESCAL anatomical scope explicitly (brain + pelvis only) to prevent downstream copy-paste onto H&N-only products.

limitations: Full text of the Buschmann 2025/2026 paper and the Aljaafari 2025 paper were not independently re-read for every numeric claim (e.g., exact dose-difference figures); title/DOI/PMID were verified against PubMed/Europe PMC/ScienceDirect abstracts and metadata only, not against the complete body text held behind publisher paywalls.

findings.suggestedFix: No action; retain the correction note for audit trail.

findings.observation: Same title mismatch as Brain product: the record's title does not match the verified PubMed/Europe PMC title ('Development of an MR-only radiotherapy treatment planning workflow using a commercial synthetic CT generator for brain and head & neck tumor patients'), and the DOI (10.1016/j.zemedi.2025.01.003) is omitted from the keyPaper object.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct title and add the DOI; keep PMID 39956751.

findings.observation: The H&N-specific n=10 figure used in evaluationData is correct as the H&N subset of the combined 23-patient study (13 brain + 10 H&N), but the record does not disclose that this is a subset of a larger combined-anatomy study, which could misleadingly imply a dedicated 10-patient H&N-only trial.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a note clarifying the 10 H&N patients are part of a combined 23-patient (13 brain + 10 H&N) single-center study, cross-referenced with the Brain product entry.

findings.observation: MESCAL (Cusumano/Maspero et al. 2026) explicitly collected data from 32 patients across only two anatomical sites: 16 brain and 16 pelvis, from two centers, testing MRI Planner (Spectronic), SyngoAI (Siemens), MR Box (Therapanacea) and MRCAT (Philips). Head & neck anatomy was NOT part of the MESCAL benchmark. Listing this paper as a keyPaper for MRCAT Head and Neck is an incorrect attribution — it provides no H&N-specific evidence for this product, confirming the directive's flagged issue.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the MESCAL keyPaper entry from philips-mrcat-head-and-neck (and from any other H&N-only product entries). Retain it only on philips-mrcat-brain, philips-mrcat-pelvis, spectronic-mriplanner, and mr-box-synthetic (and, if the 'SyngoAI' reference is confirmed to be the audited product, siemens-syngo-ct), each scoped to brain/pelvis only.

findings.observation: With the MESCAL paper removed as misattributed, the sole H&N-specific evidence is the single-center n=10 Buschmann et al. study (E1-level: single-center, vendor-independent, retrospective). The E2 rigor rating for this product appears to rest on the misattributed MESCAL multi-center benchmark; without it, rigor should likely revert to E1 pending identification of a genuine multi-center H&N-specific validation.
findings.suggestedFix: Re-evaluate evidenceRigor for philips-mrcat-head-and-neck after removing the MESCAL citation; document the rationale explicitly.

limitations: MESCAL anatomical scope (16 brain/16 pelvis) confirmed from multiple independent abstract sources (ScienceDirect, UMC Utrecht repository, LMU ART Lab); full text not accessed behind the Elsevier paywall, so supplementary tables were not checked for any secondary H&N analysis that might not appear in the abstract.
